page.content:
The Zaibatsu-hosted contest that opens every numbered war.

How King of Iron Fist Tournament connects

  • Topic: Tekken — The King of Iron Fist Tournament is the contest every numbered Tekken opens.
  • Faction: Mishima Zaibatsu — The Mishima Zaibatsu hosts the King of Iron Fist Tournament.
  • Character: Heihachi Mishima — Heihachi hosted the King of Iron Fist Tournament to draw Kazuya out.
  • Character: Paul Phoenix — Paul Phoenix has entered almost every King of Iron Fist Tournament.
  • Character: King — King is a repeating wrestler in the King of Iron Fist Tournament.

What is King of Iron Fist Tournament?

The King of Iron Fist Tournament is the in-world fighting contest the Mishima Zaibatsu stages. Winning it has meant company control, revenge, or a chance to kill a father.

Key threads lead to Tekken, Mishima Zaibatsu, Heihachi Mishima, Paul Phoenix and King.
